description:
I am an ML engineer working with PyTorch and Python. We are building ARES-MAP: an interactive, web-based 3D tactical mission planner for astronauts on Mars (Jezero Crater). We use real NASA HiRISE terrain and an ML backend predicting dynamic hazards (temperature, dust storms, radiation) to generate safe EVA routes.

Looking for:

• Godot 4 / 3D Developer (WebGL, shaders, atmospheric fog)

• Frontend Web Dev (interactive portal, UI/UX)

Clear architecture is ready—let's build a winning project!
